problem: Technical optimization could be presented as financial impact on the strength of a verified delivery receipt and an arbitrary numeric revenue field; production raw outcome observations carry truth_class=realized even for not_executed.
root_cause: The cross-domain planner lacked independent financial source/readback, unit classification, engineering-value lineage and cross-domain experiment linkage gates.
fix: Require independent finance evidence, semantic exclusion of non-value outcome units, same-revision engineering linkage, source-record deduplication and explicit controlled-comparison outcome references. Do not rewrite immutable raw observations.
prevention: Never sum conversion or delivery counts as revenue or monetary savings.
Financial benefit needs same-tenant revision-bound independent finance readback and EUR value proof.
Attribution to engineering must link to an actual verified engineering outcome.
Control comparisons must reference the same financially verified business and engineering outcome IDs and assignment readback.
Missing economics or cohort proof must remain NOT_PROVEN; protected delivery remains sole production authority.
outcome: Candidate guardrail only; real financial value not yet independently verified and production adoption not yet demonstrated.

invariants: no revenue from not_executed or sent
